title: 4708 Glennwood Dr, Killeen, TX | Elizabeth Thomas ACE Real Estate Group | Killeen, TX Real Estate
description:
Move right in and enjoy the convenience of a fantastic neighborhood! This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home boasts fresh interior paint and beautiful tile floors throughout the common areas. The rooms are spacious & all have ceiling fans. The master bath has a double vanity. The neighborhood boasts sidewalks, perfect for evening strolls. Close to everything, you'll have easy access to shops, restaurants, entertainment, and all the conveniences you need. The spacious backyard offers endless possibilities.  To sweeten the deal, the seller is even willing to help with closing costs!

-

I’m Elizabeth Thomas, your go-to 28-year-old Realtor with a passion for making dreams come true in the Lone Star State! When I’m not working for you, you can find me relaxing with my dog Tux. 🐶


In 2018 the military brought me to Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos, and it’s been an incredible journey. As a real estate professional, I’ve had the privilege of helping HUNDREDS of families find their perfect homes and navigate the exciting world of real estate. 🗝
Originally from North Carolina, I carry the warmth of Southern hospitality in my heart and the determination to go the extra mile for my clients. 💖 Whether you’re an investor seeking prime opportunities, a first-time buyer, a seller aiming to make a profitable move, or a fellow military family in need of a seamless transition, I’m here to serve and support you every step of the way. 🤝
